entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary:
The Kerensky Offensive, a 1917 Russian military campaign, marked the last significant effort by the Russian Provisional Government to regain territory lost during World War I. 

 Led by Alexander Kerensky, the offensive aimed to push the German and Austro-Hungarian armies back from the Galician front. However, it ultimately failed, with the Bolsheviks' October Revolution on the horizon and the impending collapse of the Russian army. 

 This pivotal event in modern history not only foreshadowed the rise of communism in Russia but also underscored the devastating consequences of prolonged warfare on the Russian people. 

 As the last gasp of the Russian Provisional Government, the Kerensky Offensive serves as a stark reminder of the catastrophic human cost of World War I and its lasting impact on global politics.
